[b]🐬 About WDC[/b]

[b]WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] is the leading global charity dedicated to the protection of whales and dolphins.

Their expert-led teams in the UK, Europe, the Americas, and Australasia work across a wide range of threats — from climate change and fishing gear entanglements, to pollution, captivity, and whaling.

They collaborate with scientists, businesses, NGOs, governments, and grassroots communities to create solutions.
Their mission is to [i]reverse the global decline of whale and dolphin populations[/i] and create a world where every whale and dolphin is [i]safe and free[/i].

[b]🎣 What is Ghost Gear?[/b]

Ghost gear refers to abandoned or lost fishing equipment in the ocean — and it’s a deadly threat.

When whales or dolphins become entangled in ghost gear, they may drown from being unable to surface or suffer long-term injuries.
They can carry these entanglements for weeks or months, causing deep wounds, restricted movement, and starvation.

Disposing of gear properly is difficult and expensive, which contributes to the issue.
[b]Did you know?[/b] About [b]1/3 of marine litter[/b] in European seas is discarded fishing gear — that’s over [b]11,000 tonnes[/b] per year!

WDC is working on innovative ways to combat this threat — and your support helps them make a real impact.

[b]💙 How Your Support Helps[/b]

Whales are essential to ocean health — the ocean creates more oxygen and absorbs more carbon than all forests combined, and whales help maintain this balance.
Yet every year, [b]over 300,000 whales and dolphins die[/b] in fishing gear entanglements.

notes.title: Patch 1.2.9 is here – New Quest Guide System, Combat Improvements & More!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, Shifters! 🌀[/b]

Today, we’re bringing you an update focused on Quality of Life improvements—many of which were directly requested by you, our amazing community. Patch 1.2.9 delivers a fresh wave of enhancements, bug fixes, and combat tweaks designed to make your journey through The World of Heera smoother, more intuitive, and even more enjoyable. Let’s dive into what’s new!

[h2]🐲 Changelog 1.2.9[/h2]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Grab Mechanic Overhaul:[/b] Enemies now have a chance to become “grabbable” for 4 seconds after being attacked (indicated by an icon). Use the grab button (default: "Interact" button) to grab them—charged attacks no longer grab
[*][b]Waypoint Trackers Per Player:[/b] Each player now has their own tracker in multiplayer and can see others’ trackers
[*]Tentacles now have a slower attack speed but can strike from slightly farther away
[*]Mauling a grabbed enemy ("Interact" while grabbing) now restores a small amount of health even without specific skills
[*]Removed the [i]Explosive Slam[/i] skill from the Houndra skill tree
[*]Alterant variants in a given X-series (e.g. FrX) now share a consistent alterant shape
[/list]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]New Quest Guide System:[/b] Tracked quests now show a yellow diamond icon on the map to guide you. NPCs with new quests are also marked
[*][b]Melee Combat Improvements for Mouse + Keyboard:[/b] Better targeting and movement behavior while melee attacking, especially with the cursor close to the player
[*]You can now remove a single unconfirmed point in the Skill and Beast Mastery tabs
[*]Improved environment visuals through lighting and asset placement tweaks
[*]Added air attacks for [b]Scaptor[/b] and [b]Ramox[/b]
[*]Added slight camera zoom-out 
[*]Made it more clear when a [b]Perasin[/b] has already been collected
[*]Improved code on the startup screen to reduce cases where players get stuck
[*]Alterant sequences now display the required item tags and allow you to inspect individual alterants
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the final boss didn’t reset properly after death
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the quest tracker to appear far above its intended location
[*]Map location discovery is now correctly saved and no longer resets when joining or rejoining a game
[*]Lifted enemies (using the Lift Up skill) no longer collide awkwardly with the player
[*]Various quest-related bugs have been resolved
[/list]


[h3]⚠️ Important Notice:[/h3]
Due to the changes in this update, [b]any custom control remaps will be reset[/b]. Please rebind your preferred setup after updating.

We hope this update adds more fun to your experience. As always, we truly appreciate your continued support!

If you enjoy the update, don’t forget to [b]leave a review[/b]—it helps [i]Coridden[/i] grow! 💛
For bug reports or feedback, join us on [b]Discord[/b] or contact us at: [i]contact@aftnareld.com[/i]

[b]Until next time, Shifters![/b]
[i]/Aftnareld Team 🦖[/i]

[h3]New Game +[/h3]
We’re so excited to share that a feature many of you have been asking for is finally coming to ​Coridden​ – [b]New Game+[/b]! This new mode lets you dive back into the adventure with your existing character save file, keeping all your hard-earned progress and gear. [h3]🐲 Changelog 1.2[/h3]

- New Game +: Replay with higher enemy levels and resistance penalty
- Max level increased to 80
- 2 more assignable skill slots, 6 skills can now be assigned on each form
- No helm and no creature accessory option in the cosmetics tab
- Transmog feature in the cosmetics tab
- Outline on/off option in the cosmetics tab
- New elemental weapons (both melee and ranged)
- Merchant that sells collars + creature ranged weapons in The Burrow

- Some creature forms now deal elemental melee damage
- LB RB RT LT icons bigger text

- You can now pick up items from the back of a mount

notes.title: What to expect from Coridden
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

[h3]Coridden comes out on 29 January 2025. That means [b]we're counting hours to the launch[/b], and we hope you're as excited as we are![/h3]

With that, we wanted to set up the expectations at the right level.

[h2]What is Coridden?[/h2]
[b]Coridden[/b] is an [b]indie action RPG[/b] where you play as a monster-shifter, able to transform into the creatures you defeat. Venture out [b]alone[/b] or in [b]co-op with up to 3 friends[/b] on a journey to uncover the dark secrets sealed inside the legendary city of Aasha. 

The game brings back a [b]similar vibe and fun action as old-school co-op RPGs[/b], such as the Diablo games, BG: Dark Alliance, Champions of Norrath but also those that engrossed us in their engaging narrative and side quest-hunting such as Baldur's Gate 2: Shadows of Amn. 

Coridden’s world is in a [b]sort of post-apocalyptic scenario[/b] where nature and creatures dominate, but humans still have access to highly advanced technology they do not fully understand, similar to the feel of the world in Horizon Zero Dawn.

[h2]What Coridden isn't.[/h2] 
🐲 Some mechanics might have a similar feel to Path of Exile or Diablo games, all being isometric/hack-and-slash/action RPGs. However, it's difficult to compare Coridden to them due to different scopes of production.[b] Coridden's budget and dev team is much, much smaller.[/b]

🐲 Talking of scope — [b]Coridden is not an AAA game with a huge open world.[/b] Finishing the game should take about 10-15 hours, 20-25 if you want to do all side-quests, and about 30 if you're going for all achievements.

[h3][b]🏇🏼 Riding on each other[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e21f5e36646ef776c265910210930221ed859e2b.gif[/img]

[h3]But jokes aside, what are the key elements that make Coridden… [i]Coridden[/i]?[/h3]

[h3][b]🐲 Shapeshifting[/b][/h3]
The ability to switch freely between your [b]human and beast forms[/b] and use each form's [b]strengths and skills[/b] when needed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6a100254780c2d8324550bda5022714195e4eb27.gif[/img]

[h3][b]🎮 The RPG elements[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/892c0ac37d2fccf25830a5a68fc3d675e1c48db9.png[/img]

[h3][b]🏃🏼🏃🏼‍♂️Full co-op campaign[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/8f0acf94b85d6108dceed37f250ebc967aebec88.jpg[/img]

We wanted [b]Coridden[/b] to bring back similar vibe and fun as old-school co-op RPGs, such as the [i]Diablo[/i] games, [i]BG: Dark Alliance[/i], [i]Champions of Norrath[/i] but also those that engrossed us in their engaging narrative and side quest-hunting such as [i]Baldur's Gate 2: Shadows of Amn[/i].

notes.title: Discover Quilon's New Look and More
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

[h3]We’re thrilled to share some exciting updates and news about Coridden with you! [/h3]
We've been continuously working on Coridden, and we hope you'll enjoy the improvements we’ve made.

[b]But, first of all, we've got an important announcement.[/b]

[h3]🗓️ [b]Update on Release Date[/b][/h3]
After giving it a lot of thought, we made a difficult decision to release the game with a slight delay. Instead of pushing the game out in December, we’ve agreed Coridden would benefit from having a bit more time to cook. With that in mind, [b]we’re excited to announce that Coridden will be released early next year, in Q1 2025.[/b] This additional time will allow us to further polish the game, ensuring the best possible experience we can provide. Thank you for your understanding and support in this matter.

Now, let's give you a sneak peek at the things we've changed!

[h3][b]🌇 Quilon Rebuilt[/b][/h3]
We’re excited to introduce [b]the updated capital city, Quilon,[/b] home of the Dayal siblings. The city has now a new layout and look, designed to guide you more intuitively through its charming streets. We’ve [b]removed invisible walls[/b] we were never a fan of to enhance immersion and [b]replaced the old houses with modular and performance-friendly structures.[/b] We hope you love the new vibe of Quilon as much as we do! We’re still working on adding some ambient sounds to further enhance that friendly town feel.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/b4bb9f9eb02592393c17c61f217b5b1390918d97.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/40830958e5d67ee7d760a8e2dbd285918a56ef00.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d3ddb1d5096bffaa1391193781416976f3c2b347.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/116b0870f454dafe05f51ecedb90befa8eb8e8c8.png[/img]

[h3][b]🗡️ Colour Coding Weapons[/b][/h3]
As many of you have shared your challenges in sorting through inventory items, we’ve introduced a [b]slight color-coding system[/b] to make it[b] easier to identify and find the items you’re looking for.[/b] Red indicates heat damage, green for poison, purple for electric, blue for sharp, brown for piercing, and yellow for blunt damage. We’re eager to hear your thoughts on this new feature!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c9b89b284c2111387b4d4aa3296c0330c5c2bdc2.png[/img]

[h3]💎 [b]Buying Alterant Spaces[/b][/h3]
We’re continuing to refine the Alterant system, similar to “gem slots” in other diablo-like games. You will now be able to [b]purchase additional Alterant spaces for your weapons[/b]! While it’s a bit costly, it’s a great option if you find a weapon you love but need more spaces to enhance it. We’ve also decreased the level multiplier on many Alterants, making them [b]more accessible earlier in the game[/b]. We’re still fine-tuning the balance, so stay tuned for more updates!

Thank you for being with us. We’re excited to continue improving Coridden and can’t wait for you to experience all the new features and updates!

notes.title: All About Combat in Coridden
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

[h3]Let's talk about combat in Coridden! What should you expect?[/h3]
If you’re eager to embark on a thrilling journey in the world of Coridden, let’s unravel the intricacies of its combat system. Here’s what you can expect:

[h3]💥 Action-Packed RPG Adventure[/h3]
Coridden is an Action RPG that places action and fluid movement at its core. Seamless transitions and dynamic maneuvers are what make battling in this world exhilarating. Your journey is designed to be a whirlwind of strategic choices and heart-pounding encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/60e1111d518da557365a16fbc61b7aee3fd1c5c1.gif[/img]

[h3]🐲 Unleash Your Inner Beast[/h3]
One of the unique features in Coridden is the ability to effortlessly switch between human and beast forms. Whenever you wish to change your strategy or regain stamina during a heated battle, shepshifting is as easy as a button tap. We delve into this transformative power more here:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1656930/announcements/detail/4685523041266430536

[h3]🔋 Manage Your Stamina[/h3]
As battles unfold, your character's stamina slowly depletes with each attack. What happens when you run low and need a quick recharge? Simple: switch forms! This shift offers a tactical refresh that can turn the tide in combat.

[h3]⚔️ Choose Your Arsenal[/h3]
In Coridden, flexibility is key. Equip yourself with a versatile mix of melee and ranged weapons. Switch between a trusty bow and an array of melee options like handaxes, swords, or spears. With so much variety, there’s a perfect weapon to suit every player’s taste.

[h3]🧑🏼‍🎨 Personalize Your Human Form[/h3]
Customization is at your fingertips when choosing a class for your human form. Whether you wish to focus on elemental damage or bolstering your team through healing and support, the decision shapes your future skillset. Every choice opens a new avenue for personalized gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c0d5fe517cc24341503cdc9e34c9e3df3feb82a5.gif[/img]

[h3]🌲 Explore Dual Skill Trees[/h3]
Both your human and beast forms come with distinct skill trees. As you level up, be sure to examine each tree for fresh abilities that can help you conquer increasingly challenging foes.

[h3]🏇🏼 Solo or Co-op: The Choice is Yours[/h3]
While playing solo is possible, we recommend teaming up with at least one more person for an enriched experience. Collaborating with another player can enhance strategies and make conquering the dangerous world of Coridden all the more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d9c617d20152c7c9eec98459b06fed13710ec1eb.gif[/img]

[h3]🎮 Optimized for Gamepad Play[/h3]
Although playable with mouse and keyboard, Coridden is optimized with a gamepad in mind. This means wielding your controller will provide the smoothest, most immersive experience.

[previewyoutube=9E2WhAa72SQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Dive into Coridden’s combat with these insights in mind, and prepare for an exciting adventure!

notes.title: All About Shapeshifting in Coridden
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

Today, we're embarking on a journey to explore [b]shapeshifting in Coridden[/b]. Whether you've just discovered our game or you're already played the demo, understanding the art of shapeshifting is [b] key to mastering the game[/b]. In this mini-guide, we'll delve into [b]what shapeshifting is all about[/b], [b]how you can transform into different forms[/b], and the [b]advantages it brings to your gameplay.[/b]
Let's jump into it!

[previewyoutube=87oCV97vX8s;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Why Shapeshift?[/h3]
Shapeshifting is really important in Coridden. When you change into a beast, you can [b]run faster [/b]and [b]jump higher[/b], which helps you move through the game more easily, as well as[b] access some hidden shelves and nooks[/b]. On the other hand, when you are in your human form, you can use your fingers to[b] open treasure chests[/b] and collect goodies you find along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6a39aa4389bcfe6e89147ee5f639769f98f2153e.gif[/img]

[h3]How Do You Get This Ability?[/h3]
To shapeshift, you need [b]special shards[/b]. These shards sometimes appear when you [b]beat a beast[/b] in the game. Your gauntlets can use these shards to let you turn into the beast you defeated. [b]The more beasts you beat, the more shapes you can change into![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/52c3fb8dd2a6ce164a883b9fc0c6997c862ef73b.gif[/img]

[h3]Skill Trees For All[/h3]
Every beast type has its own skills called [b]Beast Mastery[/b]. These are like skill-trees with useful abilities for you to use when you’re [b]in beast form.[/b] It's like having two characters in one because you can access both your beast and human skills anytime! Remember, [b]each beast has its own strengths and weaknesses.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e76b7e3d1b422ab126d44efa9e8f6c0ed03d6de5.gif[/img]

[h3]Play and Grow Together[/h3]
Coridden is designed as a [b]co-op adventure.[/b] You and your friends can [b]fight[/b], [b]ride[/b], and [b]complete challenges together[/b], making the game more fun and exciting as you grow and improve as a team.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d9c617d20152c7c9eec98459b06fed13710ec1eb.gif[/img]

[h3]Shapeshift Your Way to Victory! 🏇🏼[/h3]

notes.title: Exciting Updates and Enhancements!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

August is coming to an end, but it's not yet over for us! After showing Coridden at [b]Gamescom in Germany[/b], we're sending it off to [b]the US for PAX West![/b]
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1656930/announcements/detail/4255424837726846472

But that's not all! We're lucky to participate in this year's indie event at the venue — [b]The MIX![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/8181d77a461b5067c02bc8a8c92a6d81fbdf708a.png[/img]

We've also got some updates rolling in, and we can't wait to share them with you! Our recent playtesting session was a [b]success[/b], and [b]your feedback has been invaluable![/b] We've been busy fixing bugs based on it, and working on completing the game's areas, environments, texts, and translations—[b]it's all slowly coming together[/b] 😊 

To ramp up both [b]challenge [/b]and [b]fun[/b], we decided to try out some changes to [b]skills, items, and gameplay elements.[/b] Here's a peek at what's new:

[h3]🛡️ New Defence Stat for Armours[/h3]
Armours (including beast forms) will now have a [b]Defence[/b] stat. Defence is compared to the [b]Level of the attacker.[/b] If you have a [b]high defence,[/b] it will [b]decrease incoming damage[/b]. Having a[b] low defence[/b] compared to attacker level might lead to [b]more damage[/b] taken. 

We wanted to include this stat as something that every armour can provide to protect you better, even if that armour doesn't have [b]damage resistance or reduction.[/b] This allows for more varied armours, such as an armour providing [b]more ability power [/b]or [b]energy regeneration[/b] instead of just protection.

[h3]🩸 Wound Healing[/h3]
Selected armours will now have a [b]Wound Healing[/b] stat, allowing players to regenerate health while outside of combat.

[h3]🪙 Adjusted Death Penalties[/h3]
Players will now [b]lose money upon death[/b], and the time required to revive an ally has increased slightly from 1 second to 2 seconds, adding a touch more [b]challenge[/b].

[h3]💰 Economy Adjustments[/h3]
We've [b]reduced the overall money drops from enemies[/b] to make a more balanced in-game economy. We hope that as a result, completing quests will feel more rewarding and crucial to progression.

[h3]⚖️ Weapon Damage Balancing[/h3]
We've adjusted both [b]ranged [/b]and [b]melee weapon[/b] damages to maintain a consistent challenge throughout the game.

[h3]🐲 Beast Form Items Drop Rate[/h3]
We've [b]increased the drop chance for beast form items[/b].

[h3]🗡️ Expanded Inventory[/h3]
We've added [b]more inventory space[/b], allowing players to carry more of their hard-earned loot.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/1a3539f371a9c94b61a0b0246401724639ed2978.gif[/img]

[h3]⬆️ Enhanced Damage Resistance for Enemies[/h3]
Enemies' damage resistances will now [b]scale [/b]with [b]higher difficulty levels[/b] and with more players [b]in multiplayer mode[/b]. This change encourages varied playstyles and strategic builds among players tackling tougher challenges together.

[h3]🟠 Improved Item Comparison and Stats Display[/h3]
🔸Damage is now compared [b]directly[/b], regardless of damage type, helping players make quicker, more informed decisions.
🔸 If an item has more than one damage type, a [b]total damage value[/b] will be displayed alongside a breakdown of each damage type's contribution.
🔸We've [b]reorganized item stat displays[/b] to highlight [b]the most important stats at the top[/b], followed by a clear break before the rest, to streamline the comparison process.

notes.title: Q&A and Connecting with Our Community
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊[/h2]

We recently organized a Q&A session where we invited you to ask your burning questions on Discord, and [b]we're thrilled to share the answers with you today![/b] It was a fantastic opportunity for us to connect with our amazing community and provide some insights into what goes on behind the scenes 😁

We [b]prepared a video[/b] of the entire session available for you to watch. But if you're short on time, don't worry! We've also [b]summarized the key points[/b] in written form below. Enjoy!

[previewyoutube=3B1ORD9L53A;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Q: How did your team form up? [/b]
A: It started a bit after Valle and I met. We met at the university, where we were studying Chemistry, so not quite Game Development back then. But Valle had an interest in Game Development since high school, so he was developing games. He had just finished a game project and was starting a new one, and he asked me for ideas and input. I started helping, and it eventually snowballed into us working together. Finally, we started a studio in 2018 have been doing this game since. The current team has been formed through first us, and then people we met on the way.

[b]Q: How big is your team, and what are their roles? [/b]
A: The core team that works on the game daily except us two, there are two more people. We've got Oskar who's been helping us with VFX, so he's like a technical artist, and we've got Gabi who helps us with the environments and 3D assets. But we also have people who help us with music, sound, 2D art assets, etc.
[b]
Q: How did you find the idea of becoming what you kill? That's the most interesting and "exotic" feature of the game IMO! [/b]
A: At the beginning, we only had one creature you could play as and shape-shift into a human and a creature. Then we added two more, so you could always shape-shift between four forms. But progession-wise, we felt like we didn't get what we wanted; We wanted to have more possibilities of progression with the beasts, and that's when we came up with an idea that they're not just something you have all the time, but rather an ability or an item. When you defeat a beast it can drop its form and properties, and you can pick it up and become it. 

[b]Q: Did you think at any point of the game about making some PVP features? [/b]
A: No. We wanted to make a co-op game. PVP takes a long time to develop because it has to be very fair and extremely balanced. We felt like we wanted to focus on the co-op aspect and PVE rather than PVP. We decided very early that PVP won't be our focus.

[b]Q: Were there any road blocks, either from the art side or programming side, that had to have a creative workaround for the issue(s) encountered? [/b]
A: It's a hard question because, of course, we had some roadblocks here and there. We've been working on the game for so long that we tend to forget. But when we found problems with performance of the game, we had to come up with some workarounds or skip on some features. E.g. we always liked to have plenty of lights in our game — creatures, humans, environments emit light, especially in the dark areas, so a lot of things had shadows. But it soon became apparent that the shadows costed the game a lot, and we had to cut down on them a bit. It affects immersion a bit, but for now, we felt like it was more important for the game to flow well. Our game is about precision - you have to time your attacks, etc., so we didn't want performance to suffer.

[b]Q: For how long was Corriden in development? What took the longest time to make? [/b]
A: We've been developing the game since 2018. We both started working on it part-time, but we started working on the prototype even before that. We were working and studying before that, so... I don't want to count the years anymore. But we've learnt a lot along the way. What took the longest? Programming! Not only to do the programming, but to learn it as well. When we started I did make some games, but they were small and in a different programming language. So it was more or less like starting from a scratch when we started working in Unity. 

[b]Q: What is your proudest moment of what you've currently developed for Corriden? [/b]
A: It's hard to pick just one, but a whenever we went to conventions to show our game, then seeing people play it and have fun would make us proud and happy. Also, when someone plays it and streams it online or makes a video and has fun with it of course makes us happy! But the biggest milestone so far was that we managed to reach the goal for the Kickstarter. That was a really nerve-racking time and we're happy that so many people wanted to help us release the game. We'll be the most proud when we get to release the game!

[b]Q: Will there be another playtest or will it be onto full release from here? [/b]
A: Our last playtest was really good. We got a lot of reports on issues, and we're very grateful for them. We definitely want to squeeze one more. Maybe not necessarily in the same open form, but maybe for the Discord community and Kickstarter backers, so on the smaller scale. Can't promise it, but we'd love to!

[b]Q: Do you have a future goal in mind for Aftnareld Studio such as develop at least one AA or AAA game?[/b]
A: That's very hard to answer! If we got the opportunity - sure, but getting such an opportunity is really hard. You need a lot of money, and a lot of people, and it's a very big risk. Maybe we'll get to do a AA in the future, who knows, but AAA is probably out of our reach. It would be fun, though! We already have ideas for big projects! For now, our heads are in the indie space, but who knows, maybe after a couple of projects we’ll be ready for something bigger.

[b]Q: Those ideas that you've mentioned - are these more like Coridden 2, or something completely brand new?[/b]
A: Right now, we're focused on Coridden, and we're thinking on how to expand on it in the future. We haven't decided yet if there will be Coridden 2 - it depends on what we feel like we've learned after releasing Coridden. What people liked and disliked and if there's more to explore there. We'll keep this one a bit of a secret. We'll see!

[b]We had a blast answering your questions and hope you enjoyed the session as much as we did.[/b] Thank you for being such an engaged and supportive community. Your enthusiasm keeps us going! ❤️
If you have any more questions or ideas, feel free to reach out to us on Discord or any of our social media channels. We're always here to chat!

Until next time!
/Aftnareld Team

Our very first key art introduced you to [b]the Dayal siblings and their beasts forms[/b]. All four siblings were showcased in action, each displaying various fighting styles. This piece was all about [b]dynamism [/b]and the [b]raw energy of battle[/b].

First off, we want to extend[b] a huge thank you [/b]to everyone who participated in our alpha playtest. notes.title: Deadly Spin, Minimap and Stacking Effects!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲[/h2]

We're back with another changelog! As always, we've been hard at work adding more content to the game. We've shared some of the improvements in our last Dev Update - check it out if you haven't already!
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1656930/view/7723185311647615065

[h2]New moves[/h2]
Our beasts have been training hard and it shows! Not only has Ramox learned some new moves, but Panteliz has also been honing new skills. We can't wait to show you two of their new moves - what do you think?? 😀
[h3]Charged Pounce[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6865502e1f03d6029d33e0cd25918409216fc4a2.gif[/img]
[h3]Deadly Spin[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e76b7e3d1b422ab126d44efa9e8f6c0ed03d6de5.gif[/img]

[h2]Damage types and stacking effects[/h2]
In our discord we had some interesting discussion around damage types and effect stacking lately, and questions about how it works in Coridden came up. For you who are interested, here is a quick overview for how damage over time and damage status effects currently work:

Damage over time stacks. So if you successfully scorch an enemy with 10 dmg for 4 sec and then successfully scorch the same enemy 2 seconds later with 5 dmg for 2 sec, the enemy will take 15 damage for the remaining 2 seconds. However, the debuff from the damage status effect does not stack. For example, a scorched enemy always takes 50% more physical damage no matter how many "stacks" of scorch it has. Concerning area of effect (AOE) damage, if an enemy stands in 2 AOE attacks it will take damage from both. It works in the same way for both singleplayer and multiplayer.
More than inflict damage over time, each status effect also debuff enemies in different ways:

[b]🩸 Bleeding[/b]: enemies take additional elemental damage.
[b]⚗️ Poison[/b]: prevents enemies from healing.
[b]⚡ Shock[/b]: causes enemies to deal less damage, it will also decrease their accuracy and cooldown speed of abilities.

notes.title: Important Figures Behind our Protagonists ✨
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲[/h2]

In the previous update, we introduced you to our main protagonists - the[b] Dayal siblings[/b]. Today, we wanted to tell you more about the characters that are the closest to them. Let's talk about their family, their roles and challenges in a post-apocalyptic world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/2727d560709f68ec22558b29dfd9e6bc382a2153.png[/img]

[h3]Charvi – Mother of the siblings[/h3]
Charvi is a kind, caring and determined woman. She has been managing the family tech shop inherited from her and her sister Ira’s parents for many years. She raised all of her children mostly by herself, with the occasional help of their father and her sister (when they weren't busy scavenging). Many people in Quilon know that they can not only go to her to buy and fix things, but hire help to perform requests that only scavengers take upon themselves. Charvi is also known for always trying to help someone in some way, regardless of how much money someone might have.

[h3]Ira – Charvi's sister, siblings aunt[/h3]
Ira is energetic, positive and smart. She never wanted to have a family herself, but she always stayed close to Charvi and helped her raise her children as much as she could. She has a lot of joy and pride being an aunt. Ira has a brilliant, inventive mind, and loves tinkering with tech. It seems that she especially enjoys experimenting with creating new types of weapons...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/8f0acf94b85d6108dceed37f250ebc967aebec88.jpg[/img]

[h3]Najji – Father of the siblings[/h3]
Najji is a protective, calm and street-smart person. He's an explorer and scavenger who brings in all sorts of tech, parts and other resources needed for Charvi and Ira to conduct their business. Although he loves his family, he has to spend a lot of time apart from them, making sure he can provide for all of them.

There is one additional person you should definitely meet as well.

[h3]Maya - Digital mind and companion[/h3]
Maya is an artificial intelligence residing inside the gauntlets of the siblings. While we are familiar with AI, this is something they have not encountered before. Maya can see and hear everything the siblings can, and talks to them in a way that sounds just like a voice in their head. She’s there to help the ones who wear the gauntlets in any way they need, by making her calculated statements, analysis and can also interact with a lot of tech.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/58b84ee9c069874b6f0e2dd20bd5f86bf203206b.png[/img]

We hope this insight into the family dynamics has sparked your curiosity and deepened your connection with Coridden 😊 If you have any questions - we're more than happy to answer them!

notes.title: Get to know our Characters!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲[/h2]

Last time, we chatted about the power of dialogues and how your choices can influence the quest, its outcome, and even the rewards. Today, we want to introduce you a bit more to the playable characters: the Dayal siblings. The siblings are more than just colorful characters on your screen - they're people with their own unique personalities. By understanding their temperaments, you'll be better equipped to make choices in the game and avoid potential surprises. Let's get to know them better!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/a2cb50874077b9e8dba5559ec6c4d29c5161b6db.jpg[/img]

[h3]Jai - The intelligent and rational one[/h3]
As the oldest of the Dayal siblings, Jai has grown up to become a responsible individual. He is naturally intelligent and likes being rational. Sometimes Jai finds it difficult not to point out when people are wrong or use faulty reasoning. He feels pressured to take over the family business one day, which makes him feel weighed down by obligations he doesn't want to shoulder. He dreams of becoming rich and gaining the freedom to do whatever he wants to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e77d6d75cedba81aad0e9111bf9634363eb252ba.jpg[/img]

[h3]Devi - The supportive and observant one[/h3]
Devi is the second oldest of the siblings, and she’s very curious and empathetic. She’s much more interested and in tune with her and others' emotions than the other siblings. She loves helping others so much that she often forgets to take care of herself and be happy. Although Devi tries to avoid conflicts with other people, she still sometimes feels she’s not enough to be likeable. She hopes to make her family and the entire community proud of her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/38ba8b77ca331e7ac2a8e647c2eab85b0de153fa.jpg[/img]

[h3]Lilly - The hot-tempered and brutally honest one[/h3]
The second-youngest, the most daring and ambitious of her siblings, with a sole goal to become the strongest. She was still a child, when she got badly hurt and lost in a fight to defend her sibling, and from then on promised herself to never lose again. Lilly doesn't like showing off any weaknesses, and her short fuse often ends up in harsh comments or fights with others. While her siblings can appreciate her honesty, people who don't know her often take offence to her straight-forward nature and lack of social skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c0b6aa165da10d70219c432dadd5bc2fb4429017.jpg[/img]

[h3]Eshan - The charming and manipulative one[/h3]
Being the youngest of the siblings, he has always looked up to his siblings and hopes to be as smart, dedicated, and tough as them. He quickly realized, however, that his real strength lies in his charm and wits. Although his inexperience and naiveté can sometimes be a hindrance to his goals, he has little trouble lying and manipulating to get what he wants. And, with his busy and talented family, he often feels like he is not as valuable and good enough as the others. He dreams of becoming famous and popular, someone respected and important among the townsfolk.

We hope this insight into their personalities and family dynamics has sparked your curiosity and deepened your connection with our game. Thank you all for your continuous support and enthusiasm. It really means the world to small studios like ours ❤

notes.title: More Than Just Words: Exploring Dialogue System in Coridden
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲 [/h3]

[b]When you play through Coridden's story, you're not restricted to being a passive listener. [/b]You can be an active participant in the unfolding narrative, and be given options to [b]dig deeper for more information[/b], [b]decide how to solve a problem[/b], or even [b]select the type of reward you desire[/b]. Each choice you make can lead to new secrets, quests, and outcomes, all dependent on the situation and the NPC/quest at hand.

In Coridden, [b]your character's personality matters[/b]. The siblings in the game have different approaches to people and problems, and this can open up unique choices and quests. [b]The rewards and outcomes are not always the same[/b], they change based on the character you are playing and the choices you make.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d9c617d20152c7c9eec98459b06fed13710ec1eb.gif[/img]

You already know that you can play Coridden solo or in co-op with your friends. But how does making decisions work when there is more than one person playing? [b]Here is where our voting system comes in![/b]

We decided to implement a system that ensures every player has a chance to read the dialogues, and have their say in the choices presented. [b]Every player always needs to press the "confirm" button to continue a dialogue.[/b] However, to make sure the flow doesn't get too slow, as soon as one player has pressed "continue" [b]a timer starts.[/b] When the timer runs out, it means that the dialogue will continue regardless of every player having confirmed.

When there are multiple options available, each player can vote for the answer they prefer.[b] If there is a tie, a 50-50 chance determines the selected option. [/b]Even if the majority leans towards one option, [b]there is still a chance for the less popular choice to be selected.[/b] This makes sure every vote is always viable, and adds a fun element of unpredictability to the dialogue outcome!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/65419516365701da2c7672a8cd125928e29020e1.gif[/img]

We believe that our dynamic dialogues in Coridden will provide a unique and engaging gaming experience. Each choice you make, each dialogue you engage in, is a step towards shaping your own adventure. So come, step into the world of Coridden, and let your choices speak for themselves!

notes.title: Unveiling the Secrets of Aasha: The Story of Coridden
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲 [/h3]

While Coridden's visuals and smooth multiplayer gameplay may be eye-catching, there's an important layer of the game that's hard to show through screenshots and GIFs. Beneath its visual surface lies a [b]story [/b]that weaves together elements of [b]adventure[/b], [b]mystery[/b], and the[b] indomitable spirit of humanity.[/b] Let's explore it together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/4fd4639be97cd53dcf1761dc7cf6ab1b31f38987.png[/img]

Coridden's post-apocalyptic narrative is set on a distant planet, where remnants of old human society and technology are scattered across a landscape [b]reminiscent of Earth's Mesozoic Era.
[/b]
The story takes place many years after a mysterious disaster forced colonists to leave their city and the advanced technology that used to keep them alive. The colonists have since built a new city, learning to adapt and survive in a [b]world where dangerous reptile beasts roam freely.[/b]

A group of brave people called the [b]"Scavengers"[/b] go into dangerous places to find resources and artifacts that were left behind after a catastrophic event. Our protagonists, the [b]Dayal siblings[/b], become a part of this group after their lives take an unexpected turn when they equip ancient hi-tech devices that grant them [b]extraordinary shapeshifting powers.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6a39aa4389bcfe6e89147ee5f639769f98f2153e.gif[/img]

With this newfound ability, they embark on a thrilling journey into the unknown, seeking answers about [b]the true nature of these artifacts.[/b] Their quest leads them to[b] the city of Aasha[/b], long abandoned and sealed-off by their ancestors 200 years prior.

As the siblings draw closer to Aasha, they uncover unnerving signs of something concealed within the city's protective barriers. This discovery starts a [b]race against time [/b]to prevent the release of something that should remain locked away forever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/581e9dec7a06b960259a43faa525c6344048133d.png[/img]

Don't let the post-apocalyptic setting mislead you.[b] The story in Coridden isn't just about survival, but also about the human spirit's resilience and the lengths we go to protect our world. [/b]We hope you'll join us on this adventure and help the Dayal siblings unravel the mysteries of their past to secure their future.

notes.title: A Journey Through the World of Coridden ✨
notes.content:

We are back with more detailed information about our game, Coridden! Last time, we talked about customization options for your human and beast forms, allowing you to tailor your character to your personal play style. Today, we're thrilled to take you on a journey through the [i][b]World of Coridden[/b][/i] ✨

Our main town, [b]Quilon[/b], is a bustling hub of activity. Here, players can [b]interact with different NPCs, hear their personal stories and get some quests.[/b] The building which players will most likely visit the most is called [b]the Dayal House[/b] — the players' family home. It offers a chance to [b]craft and assemble alterants, store items, and reset or unlearn skills.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/f00224887731fb6d38392e046cf604709cafe22b.png[/img]

Quilon also nests an [b]arena [/b]and various [b]shops [/b]where players can purchase new gear or upgrade their existing one. But this town is more than just a marketplace; it's also the [b]starting point for our players' journey[/b] into the wider World of Coridden ✨

The world outside Quilon is vast and varied, with [b]beautiful biomes[/b] designed to [b]encourage exploration.[/b] These levels are built around a central open area, with linear side-tracks for those who want to delve deeper. We designed these levels to give a sense of openness and freedom, encouraging players to [b]keep their eyes open[/b]. In certain places, obstacles can be overcome by figuring out [b]environmental puzzles, jumping or swimming.[/b] We reward the effort! 🏆

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d8e2de6f627adc13aff229c5c80217e4a31a721c.png[/img]

As players progress through the main story, they'll uncover [b]new areas to explore[/b]. Each area has its own main hub and many smaller sub-areas, all of which can be explored without encountering a loading screen. This seamless exploration allows players to fully immerse themselves in the world of Coridden, whether they're [b]revisiting a favorite spot [/b]or [b]embarking on a quest in a new area.[/b]

In each area, players will find at least one [b]Safe Camp[/b], which acts as a save point. Additionally, we scattered around [b]fast travel stations[/b] that allow players to quickly move between any stations they've previously discovered and powered up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/23d8858b52e47901944eb34272b854c452d7741b.png[/img]

We wanted to create a place where people can explore, face different challenges, and progress at their own pace. We hope you'll enjoy your journey through Coridden's enchanting realm as much as we enjoyed creating it 😊

notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲 [/h3]

In our last update, we delved into the process of levelling up human form in Coridden. Today, we wanted to pull back the curtain and give you a closer look at another equally important aspect of our game — [b]the Beast Forms and their [i]Masteries[/i][/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6a39aa4389bcfe6e89147ee5f639769f98f2153e.gif[/img]

[b]Each beast type has their own Beast Mastery[/b], meaning their own skill-tree with passive and active skills that work in a similar way as the Human Classes. These skills are usable when being in your beast form, essentially meaning you build two characters in one, as [b]you have access to both at any time[/b]! Each Beast Mastery usually has up to 3 damage types to specialize into, giving you the opportunity to customize your beast form to your liking 😊

To gain skill points for upgrading a certain Beast Mastery, you have to [b]gain experience points while having that beast form equipped[/b]. To begin with, every Beast Mastery includes one skill tree (or skill tab, as we like to call them). However, as you level up, you will be able to unlock a second skill tab, where you will be able to select one out of six skill tabs (it's six for now, but this number might change). These secondary tabs are available for all creature types, and give you a chance to specialize your creature even further to match your play style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/49cdaf6f2d14337f2d490f5c6058e86b887f825d.jpg[/img]
[i]An example of Beast Masteries for Panteliz[/i]

[h2]Every beast has their own style, as well as strengths and weaknesses, which are reflected in their Beast Mastery.[/h2]
Here's a brief description of each beast:
[h3]🐲 [b]Panteliz[/b][/h3]
A swift predator that has camouflage and regenerative abilities, but can also pounce and spin to deal a lot of area damage. Skills usually deal sharp, poison or electric damage.

[h3]🐲 [b]Houndra[/b][/h3]
A crazed beast that loves to leap and bite; Its quick attacks and low skill cooldowns means it can always stay in action. Skills usually deal sharp, blunt and/or heat damage.

[h3]🐲 [b]Ramox[/b][/h3]
A tough and easily riled up beast that likes to charge into battle head first. Skills usually deal blunt and/or heat damage.

[h3]🐲 [b]Roker[/b][/h3]
A powerful elemental beast that likes to cast many and various skills from a distance. Skills usually deal poison and/or electric damage.

[h3]🐲 [b]Dragolem[/b][/h3]
An almost unbreakable and sturdy beast that uses stones and crystals to perform attacks covering a lot of area. Skills usually deal blunt and/or piercing damage.

[h3]🐲 [b]Scaptor[/b][/h3]
A beast that has a deadly focus, uses skills that deal a lot of damage on one target or small area. Skills usually deal piercing, heat and/or poison damage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c0dbc84c86b1b763d773ab8c22e5cd196fe884fb.gif[/img]

[b]We strongly encourage you to play as different beasts and find your favorite through trial and error.[/b] If you have multiple versions of the same beast, don't hesitate to pick different Masteries for them and see what works best for your team or your personal play style. But most of all — [b]have fun[/b]! 😊

notes.title: From Guardian to Surge: Exploring Coridden's Class System 🔎
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲 [/h3]

We're incredibly happy that so many of you played the DEMO during the still ongoing Next Fest on Steam 😍 During one of the streams we had someone ask if picking a character at the beginning of the game ties them to a class. We wanted to clarify, that [b]you can pick whichever class you want[/b], it's not tied to any of the characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c29d02a292d33428078ee239888441786dbc09e3.gif[/img]

While you can get a sense of the classes in the demo, they are just a preview. In the final version of the game, there will not only be changes to the skills, but the class system itself will work a little bit differently. So in this update we wanted to share a bit more about the [b]class system[/b], and also show you our[b] brand new icons representing each class[/b]!

When your character reaches level one, you can pick between the four classes: Guardian, Hunter, Hellion or Surge. In-game, you can take a look at each class skill trees before deciding on one. As soon as you have allocated a point to a skill in a class, then that class is set for your character.

[b]Each class contains three skill trees[/b], or skill tabs as we also like to call them, and each tab has a theme. You start with one tab, and then the other tabs [b]unlock at certain levels[/b]. After you've unlocked all of them you can freely pick and choose what you like between the tabs! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/48c6fc858cf15a4019b6d3dd815140dbbe91b7ff.png[/img]

[b]Guardian[/b]
Skill tabs: Punisher, Protector and Commander.
A sturdy fighter that lives to protect and aid their teammates, but also to punish any enemies that stand against them with devastating blunt damage. Their various shield abilities can both protect and retaliate incoming damage, and their leader aura can boost everyone towards victory. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/09eb08ef3837f49a5d9f63d046415838d53cbe08.png[/img]

[b]Hunter[/b]
Skill tabs: Ranger, Trickster, Summoner.
A cunning archer and swordsman, that prefers to take out enemies from a distance with powerful ranged skills or with their agility and prowess rather than raw strength. They can specialize in using various tools such as traps, camouflage and poison or learn to summon all kinds of creatures to aid them in battle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e90028da6ae2b839b8061c12ebf20c26f8467216.png[/img]

[b]Hellion[/b]
Skill tabs: Heat, Devotion, Hate.
A passionate warrior with heat as their primary element. They can channel their hate to sacrifice themselves and do great damage output with fire and piercing damage, but also give into their devotion and unlock powerful healing abilities for themselves and their teammates. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/517fc733b813ee43721c119ca8e455fabdaae90b.png[/img]

[b]Surge[/b]
Skill tabs: Energy, Electricity, Time.
A caster and master manipulator that can unleash powerful electric attacks to end their foes. They can shape time or energy to their will, enabling them to control their enemies and aid both themselves and their teammates to keep them energized throughout the battle.

There are five tiers of skills within each skill tab. Initially, you can only choose to upgrade skills from the first tier, but as you spend more skill points you'll unlock new tiers and even more skills to pick from. In each skill tab, you'll find both active and passive skills, and each skill can be upgraded multiple times.

We hope this sheds some light on [b]Human Classes in Coridden[/b]. Keep in mind that these are separate to what your beast form can do, though!

Is there anything you'd like to know more about? Let us know in the comments below!

notes.title: All you need to know about ✨Alterants✨
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲 [/h2]

When we embarked on the journey of creating the fascinating, somewhat post-apocalyptic world of Coridden, we found ourselves building every element, every item, and every mechanic from scratch. This also included coming up with unique names for these components. If you've tuned into our stream (thank you!), you've probably heard us mention something called "[i]Alterants[/i]". But what exactly are these mysterious elements and how do they impact the gameplay? That's exactly what we wanted to talk about today. [b]Let's unravel the mystery of Alterants together![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/e9614aba5d47207664b18520d5a45e8208cd74c6.gif[/img]

In Coridden, players have the opportunity to modify their gear through the use of Alterants, or Alts for short. These can be obtained in multiple ways, e.g. [b]through defeating enemies, opening chests, or disassembling weapons[/b]. To equip Alts, players will need to [b]visit their home base[/b], the Dayal House, located in Quilon, and [b]use the workbench[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/2727d560709f68ec22558b29dfd9e6bc382a2153.png[/img]

Every item in the game that has at least one Alterant Space can be enhanced with an Alterant. [b]Items can have anywhere from 0 to 6 Alterant spaces[/b], each represented by different shapes: [b]Force (Diamond), Finesse (Circle), and Prime (Rectangle)[/b]. It's important to note that the shape of the Alterant must match the shape of the Alterant space, with the exception of the Prime space, which can accept any type of Alterant. Some Alterants also may have specific item type requirements, such as [b]bow, melee, armor,[/b] or [b]creature form[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/b435edb7b36a8a84b7c80ba8252c5b95f620103b.png[/img]

Every Alterant has one or two [b]modifiers [/b]that affect the item you're inserting them in. The Alterant category decides what type of modifiers the Alt can have. [b]Force Alterants[/b] can modify the item’s damage per second, while [b]Finesse Alterants[/b] affect other base stats such as health and energy. [b]Prime Alterants[/b], on the other hand, provide special benefints, such as “skill on strike” or “convert damage type”.

Each Alterant's modifier values are randomized - meaning you can find two Alts that do the same thing, but one does it[b] a bit better[/b]. So it can be worth to always keep a lookout for even better Alts to use!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6a100254780c2d8324550bda5022714195e4eb27.gif[/img]

[b]Players can always disassemble an item with Alterants[/b], and get the Alts back to use them into another item. This allows players to experiment with different Alts, trying out various combinations until they find the one that[b] suits their playstyle the best[/b]. However, there's a currency cost associated with assembling weapons with Alts, and some Alts will raise the item level requirement, so [b]choose wisely![/b]

We leave the power to create the perfect weapon in your hands. Experiment, explore, and most of all, have fun 😊

notes.title: Attributes? What are those? 🤔
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲  [/h2]
 
We think that[b] a fun RPG lets you customize and specialize your character in different ways[/b]. So when developing Coridden, we wanted to find ways for players to do just that. Instead of just passively getting better when gaining a level, we added an [b]attribute system[/b] where you can choose what your character should become better at. In this update, we want to dive a bit more into how attributes work in our game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/d759d1c2532df30d5e8869d306cd171cfe1f052f.png[/img]
The five attributes to choose from — Power, Fragmentation, Stabilization, Battery, and Element — each one enhances a different aspect of your character. Whenever a player[b] levels up their gauntlets[/b], they'll gain 2 attribute points to freely assign to any of the 5 attributes. There's also possible to find [b]additional attribute points[/b] scattered around the world, so remember to explore, and your efforts will be rewarded ✨

The attributes give various passive upgrades to your characters, both to your human and your monster form:
🐲 [b]Power[/b] —  increases physical melee damage;
🐲 [b]Fragmentation[/b] —  increases physical projectile damage and status effect’s damage over time (for example, if you manage to poison an enemy it deals more damage);
🐲 [b]Stabilization[/b] — improves health and reduces the chance to get staggered by the enemy;
🐲 [b]Battery[/b] — increases max energy and energy recharge rate;
🐲 [b]Element [/b]—  increases elemental damage and ability power (which in turn improves some active skills).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/dab38b913ac9b5c0150bfbbcc0fb24918ce126d7.gif[/img]

Attributes are not only important for these passive bonuses, however, as some skills might benefit and be improved from certain attributes — so [b]you can improve skills by upgrading attributes[/b]!

Do you upgrade your gauntlet's power to increase physical melee damage? Or do you focus on fragmentation to improve your projectile physical damage and damage over time? [b]The choice is yours[/b].

What build will you be going for? Let us know in the comments!

notes.title: A Close Look at Combat! 💥
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Shifters! ✊🐲 [/h2]

In Coridden, we wanted the combat system to not only [b]test players' reflexes and fast decision-making[/b], but also to [b]encourage communication and collaboration[/b] among team members. The different items and abilities can make the battle better or worse, depending on what kind of enemy they face and how fast they react.  

[h3]Here are four aspects we kept in mind to create the combat challenging in Coridden:[/h3]
[h3]🐲 Reacting[/h3]
responding to threats, taking actions, and controlling your character;
[h3]🐲 Targeting[/h3]
analyzing enemies, planning out take-down order, using the right tools;
[h3]🐲 Managing energy (a resource to perform attacks and certain skills)[/h3]
balancing defense vs attack, risk vs safety;
[h3]🐲 Playing as a team[/h3]
talking to each other to eliminate the right targets, managing energy and targets between players, helping each other in need, making use of everyone's strengths & tools, compensating for each other's weaknesses.

During combat, players can use [u]melee and ranged attacks [/u]depending on their equipment, and choose between [b]light (faster) or charged (slower, but more powerful) attacks[/b]. Charged attacks are extra useful when the enemy is blocking attacks or has a lot of damage reduction!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c4961b56058744972c238b3f05b721bee5cf50ae.gif[/img]

There are several ways for players to avoid attacks or create some distance between them and their enemies, such as [b]dodge, jump or sprint[/b]. Dodging makes you invincible against most attacks for a short while, and doesn't cover as much distance to keep you in close proximity for counter-attacks. By jumping you can avoid attacks that travel along the ground, and it also opens up for airborne attacks.

[b]Players can change their form at will[/b] to use skills available to either their human or beast forms. Every attack and active skills costs energy, so switching between forms is essential to keep dealing damage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/6a39aa4389bcfe6e89147ee5f639769f98f2153e.gif[/img]

A teammate in a beast form, or a conjure, [b]can be mounted[/b]. Attacks from enemies won't hurt the human riding, only the beast will take damage. If the player in beast form loses consciousness or gets hit by certain attacks, the riding player will be [b]knocked off[/b]. Some skills let the rider and the mounted player to interact in special ways, while some of the passive abilities can give extra benefits while riding or being ridden.

Some creatures can [b]grab or hold onto enemies[/b] by either attacking them with a powerful attack or by running into them quickly. Sometimes [b]an enemy can dodge or block a grab attempt[/b], though. It's easier to grab enemies who've just been hit, are staggered and hurt. Other players can also attack the enemy that has been grabbed, both from the ground and while riding.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/c0dbc84c86b1b763d773ab8c22e5cd196fe884fb.gif[/img]

We hope the style of combat in Coridden got you excited! Remember that you can now [b]play the DEMO on Steam[/b]!

Until next time!
/Aftnareld Team

As you probably know, we recently launched a DEMO. Yes, you can now [b]play the DEMO for Coridden on Steam![/b] We encourage you to share your feedback, either here on the forum or on our [url=https://discord.gg/XBnqA9t85E]Discord[/url]. It's an invaluable help ❤️

Meanwhile, we really wanted to share with you the reasons we decided to create an [b]action-packed RPG[/b] filled with [b]monsters [/b]and [b]co-op[/b]. Why this type of game and not any other?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/125b67db42080fd8cfdc8dd6b582b04a64d88dfe.png[/img]

Before we started making Coridden, [b]we consumed a LOT of co-op games together[/b], especially all kinds of action and RPG games. At some point, we felt as if we had played every title in the genre possible, and we wondered "Why aren't there more?". Valle, who has been programming as a hobby since his late teens, was inspired to start a new project. And he invited me to participate in it too 😊 

We definitely wanted it to include [b]meaningful co-op[/b], in the sense of [b]not just running side by side[/b], but also interacting with each other. The mechanic of driving the warthog in Halo together came to mind as that type of co-op interaction we wanted to include. But I really love animals (especially horses) and Pokémon is one of my all-time favorite game series, so I suggested switching out the vehicle to animals instead 👉👈 Valle agreed, but he didn't want to play as “just” an animal. He wanted to play as a fierce beast! As we argued about who was going to be the beast and who was going to be the human, we realized it would be more fun to just [b]alternate between both[/b]. And that's how the [b]shapeshifting and co-op riding[/b] ideas were born! 🎉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/08ee5aecdf799b549d5014830d05bf9232b110f2.png[/img]

[b]Originally, we only had one beast,[/b] and it would certainly be a good game with that focus as well. But because we both liked different creatures, we wanted to make many different types. We ended up with multiple beast, each type having a unique base move set. We also left room for variations on their stats and looks, and made sure they can be customized with abilities and attacks, but that feels like it deserves its own post 😅

We hope you liked our story. And who knows, maybe you'll get inspired to create your game as well 😉
/Narin and the Aftnareld Team

[*] [b]Main Menu UI/UX Improvements:[/b] We hope that our latest changes will make it easier to handle save files and setting up your game. (There are still areas in the Main menu we are planning to improve/change)
[*] [b]Dropdown option list for items in inventory:[/b] With these new options you can do standard actions such as drop, equip etc, but also mark items as “trash” or “favorite” to easier manage your inventory and sell the items you are not interested in keeping.

[*] [b]Added possibility to choose dialogue answers with keyboard numbers (1,2,3,4) [/b]
[*] [b]Updated Item compare function:[/b] So now all relevant stats are shown on both items always (Example: If you equip a armor with money picking +10% it will now tell you will lose 10% money picking when switching to a armor that doesn't have that effect)
[*] [b]Added new VFX for charging weapons:[/b] To more clearly indicate when your weapon is fully charged to perform a stronger attack.

It’s summer time for us, meaning that we are taking a bit more time to actually go outside and get some sunshine to recharge our batteries, but the game is nevertheless progressing! 

In this update we wanted to start by sharing some new VFX and types of Creature Ranged Items. There are now a total of 5 different types of ranged items: Breath, Shot, Spit, Blast and Beam. notes.title: Coridden Demo is live!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello adventurers![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40886702/0210af35de7e3689cf77db69751c45e1ed800d97.png[/img]

As a part of the Dreamhack Beyond festival, the Coridden Demo is now available to download and play! You can try out this early preview until 01/08-2021. Both [b]Steam Remote Play[/b] and our [b]alpha online multiplayer[/b] are available so you can invite someone to play as well! The demo usually takes between 30 min - 1h to play, depending on your playstyle.  

One of our main reasons to put out this demo is because we need and value your feedback. We hope you will enjoy it, despite the rough edges, and if you have some time to [b]let us know your thoughts about the game![/b]
[list]
[*] You can submit feedback through our website: [url=https://www.coridden.com/feedback/ ]https://www.coridden.com/feedback/ [/url]
[*] Or you can join or Discord, and chat with us directly: [url=https://discord.gg/invite/fFdRsDW6Af ]https://discord.gg/invite/fFdRsDW6Af [/url]
[*] If none of these suit you, feel free to reach out on any of our other social media platforms. 
[/list]
Have a great weekend, hope to hear from you soon!
/Aftnareld
